title: Simple Hash Map
description: Write a Zig program that implements a simple hash map with linear probing for collision resolution.
hints: Linear probing: when a collision occurs, check the next slot
Use `%` (modulo) for the initial hash index
The while loop with index = (idx + 1) % size handles wrap-around
Initialize arrays with `[_]KV{ ... } ** N` repeat syntax
